subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should explicitly configured agentDir become an additional trusted bootstrap prompt source, or should workspace remain canonical with warnings for agentDir bootstrap files?
rationale: Current source and docs support workspace-owned bootstrap files, while loading agentDir files would expand a security-sensitive prompt authority boundary and change upgrade behavior for existing configured agents.

options.title: Land warning-only diagnostics
options.body: Preserve workspace as the only bootstrap prompt source, warn when bootstrap-named files are found in agentDir, and update docs or doctor guidance for the self-serve fix.

options.title: Adopt explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Treat explicitly configured agentDir as a trusted per-agent bootstrap source, but require clear merge rules, diagnostic alignment, docs, tests, and security review before merge.

options.title: Defer pending design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue and candidate PRs open while maintainers decide the permanent prompt-source boundary.

recommendation.title: Land warning-only diagnostics
recommendation.body: Preserve workspace as the only bootstrap prompt source, warn when bootstrap-named files are found in agentDir, and update docs or doctor guidance for the self-serve fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on bootstrap resolver ownership and broader agent-runtime boundaries among the sampled likely owners.
